title: Understanding the Singular Value Matrix
text: The matrix S is a diagonal matrix with singular values on the diagonal. The rank of a matrix is determined by the number of non-zero singular values.

title: Counting Non-Zero Singular Values
text: Look at the diagonal of the matrix S. How many non-zero values do you see?

title: Determine the Rank
text: The rank of the matrix X is equal to the number of non-zero singular values in S. How many non-zero singular values are there?
